rules_of_thumb: Quote the customer per piece only. Never share the per-kg rate. Use the calculators to convert.

VCI 19000: one 50 g pouch per 10 cu ft.
Zorbit container poles: 20 ft container 10–12 poles; 40 ft container 20 poles.
